description: A non-combat tour of ambient office life, hosted by Ama Owusu. Five staff follow their needs: they queue for coffee, meet at the water cooler, tidy, lock or leave their screens, and stay late. Nothing to solve; watch the office run itself.
test_objective: A guided demo of the office-life features on existing engine behaviour: needs and affordances, a single-capacity coffee queue, a coupled cooler exchange, screen-lock habits, carried items, a player lever (the coffee socket), and evening routines, with no VM and no combat.
